video.title: FULLTANK FRIDAY: Why Your Bad Habit Keeps Coming Back.
video.description:
Just quitting a bad habit isn't enough—if you leave an empty space in your life, that old habit is just going to move right back in. Instead of constantly beating yourself up over what you're trying to stop, focus on what you're trying to build. Pour your energy into a new, meaningful habit and let a God-sized dream pull you forward.
